title: A plan whose goal says a row or file is never delivered plants each kind of file the delivery copies, not only the one the story names
goal: step 6 of the kb-sprint skill's plan section asks, for a goal clause that a thing is never copied, delivered or published, for one planted case per kind of file that route copies (run files, usage and ops sidecars, findings, work files), so a story that handles two kinds does not leave the third to the review

run:
t = open(".claude/skills/kb-sprint/SKILL.md", encoding="utf-8").read()
i = t.find("## plan")
j = t.find("## start")
plan = t[i:j]
assert "file family" in plan or "each kind of file" in plan, "the plan step does not ask for one planted case per kind of file a delivery or copy clause covers"
